Measured the RAM of the new long-lived features on a cold start.

## Numbers
| Feature | RAM | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Office view | 18 MB | canvas buffers |
| Radar | 42 MB | findings index |
| Services | 9 MB | one block per service |
| Notes | 3 MB | |
| Jobs queue | 1 MB | |
| Council | 27 MB | transcripts kept |

## Verdict
Radar is the one to watch: it grows with the findings and never drops them. I logged it in open-issues under RAM watch.
